info.title: moonvalley/text-to-video
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "moonvalley/text-to-video", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for Moonvalley's text-to-video prompt route. Moonvalley declares no single required field here, so the only structural narrowing is that an empty body is refused.

200.description: OK - the provider's native result document, returned unchanged. Comfy has not described this model's output yet, so neither its shape nor its media type is narrowed here; the provider's own documentation is authoritative.
